headline: 'Gold' this morning +50 baht, 'Ruppapan' sells at 66,700 baht
summary: Thai gold prices opened 50 baht higher, but international gold fell $6.31 as bond yields surged after the Fed remained uncertain about inflation. Domestic gold bars sold at 66,700 baht.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and its price tends to fall when real yields rise and make non-yielding assets less attractive.
